{{Top}}
A '''task force''' was a deployment of [[Starship/Legends|ships]] or [[Trooper/Legends|troops]].<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

During the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], multiple [[Division/Legends|divisions]] of [[Republic trooper]]s could be temporarily be grouped into Task Forces.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] were considered to be a task force.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> One Star Destroyer and its escorts also formed a task force.<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

A [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] leading a task force could control the [[fire-control center]] of each individual ship under it with a [[computer/Legends|computer]], thus creating firing patterns and maximizing the use of weapons.<ref name="JK" />
